description: Election Conmission - Mr. Jagath Samarawickrama has been declared elected as a Member of the Ninth Parliament for the No. 18 - Polonnaruwa District
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to the death of a member, which is an electoral process matter. It involves the Election Commission's actions under the Parliamentary Elections Act and the Constitution to declare a new Member of Parliament for a specific electoral district. This content falls squarely within the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral processes, candidate declarations, and filling vacancies in elected positions.
